x-data="pocTesterComponent()"
{ bearerToken: '', endpoint: '/api/v1/demo/sales', params: {}, response: null } U->>Alpine: 貼上 Bearer Token
"tk_a1b2c3d4_X9z8...L5k4"
選擇 endpoint = "/api/v1/demo/inventory"
填入 params = { sku: "SKU-001" } U->>Alpine: 點擊 [呼叫] Alpine->>Alpine: validate (bearerToken 非空) Alpine->>Alpine: isLoading = true（按鈕 disable + spinner） Alpine->>Fetch: call(endpoint, params, bearerToken) Fetch->>Fetch: build URL: /api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=SKU-001
Headers: { Authorization: "Bearer tk_a1b2c3d4_X9z8...L5k4", Accept: "application/json" }
(Bearer 端點不需 X-CSRF-Token；§6.1) Fetch->>Auth: GET /api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=SKU-001 (Bearer) Auth->>Auth: extract Bearer token from Authorization header Auth->>Auth: tokenHash = SHA256(rawToken) Auth->>ApiBC: SELECT id, status, user_id
FROM erp_token.api_tokens
WHERE token_hash = $hash AND status = 'active' alt Token 有效 ApiBC-->>Auth: { id, status: 'active', userId: 'alice@erp-org.com' } Auth->>Auth: HttpContext.User = ClaimsPrincipal(userId, erp_role) Auth->>ApiBC: UPDATE api_tokens SET last_used_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $id (1s throttled) Auth->>PocBC: forward request (User 載入完成) alt SKU 存在於 mock 資料 PocBC->>PocBC: lookup mock data: skuMap["SKU-001"] PocBC-->>Fetch: 200 OK
{ sku: "SKU-001", productName: "示範產品 A", quantity: 1234, warehouse: "TPE-W01", updatedAt: "2026-05-08T13:00:00Z" } Fetch-->>Alpine: response payload + status: 200 Alpine->>Alpine: response = { ... }
statusBadge = green
isLoading = false Alpine-->>U: 顯示 JSON response（pretty-print）+ status badge 200 else SKU 不存在 PocBC-->>Fetch: 404 Not Found
{ error: "SKU_NOT_FOUND", sku: "SKU-001" } Fetch-->>Alpine: response.error Alpine->>Alpine: response = error
statusBadge = red 404 Alpine->>Toast: show("error", "查無此 SKU") end else Token 無效（hash 找不到） ApiBC-->>Auth: empty result Auth-->>Fetch: 401 Unauthorized
{ error: "INVALID_TOKEN" } Fetch-->>Alpine: 401 status Alpine->>Alpine: response = { error: "Token 無效或已撤銷" }
statusBadge = red 401
isLoading = false Alpine-->>U: P06 Inline Error（不觸發全頁 Login redirect — Bearer 與 Cookie 解耦） else Token 已撤銷 ApiBC-->>Auth: empty (status='revoked' 不符合 WHERE) Auth-->>Fetch: 401 { error: "TOKEN_REVOKED" } Fetch-->>Alpine: 401 status Alpine->>Alpine: response = error
statusBadge = red 401 Alpine-->>U: P06 顯示「Token 已撤銷，請重新建立」 end Note over U: 完整一次 request-response-UI 循環結束（≈ 80~250ms 視 mock 處理時間） ``` ## 互動完整循環 | 階段 | 元件 | 動作 | |------|------|------| | 1. 使用者輸入 | P06 Razor Page + Alpine `x-model` | bearerToken / endpoint / params 三欄位繫結 | | 2. 點擊呼叫 | `pocTesterComponent.call()` | validate → set isLoading → fetch | | 3. Fetch 攔截 | `AuthFetchInterceptor` | 不注入 CSRF（Bearer endpoint）；建構 Authorization header | | 4. Auth Middleware | `ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler` | SHA256 hash → DB lookup → 設 ClaimsPrincipal | | 5. PocBC 處理 | static mock data lookup | 200 / 404 / 401（不寫 DB） | | 6. UI 更新 | `pocTesterComponent.response = ...` | JSON pretty-print + status badge + Toast on error | ## 安全規則（FRONTEND §6.2、§7.2-C） - Bearer Token 僅存 Alpine `x-data` memory；**禁止** localStorage / sessionStorage / Cookie - `console.log` 不輸出 Token 全文（PRD P12.3） - P06 Bearer 401 **僅 inline 錯誤**，不觸發全頁 Login redirect（Bearer 與 Session Cookie 解耦） - POC endpoints 完全靜態 mock，不寫 DB（PocDemoBC `Owned DB Tables = 無`）
expected_html:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as N8N Operator (Browser)
    participant P06UI as P06 Razor Page (/Demo)
    participant Alpine as Alpine.js pocTesterComponent
    participant Fetch as AuthFetchInterceptor
    participant Auth as ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler
    participant ApiBC as ApiTokenBC (Bearer 驗證)
    participant PocBC as PocDemoBC (static mock)
    participant Toast as ToastSystem

    Note over U,PocBC: 主交互流程：操作 P06 Demo Console 完整呼叫一次 POC API

    U->>P06UI: GET /Demo
    P06UI-->>U: 200 HTML<br/>x-data="pocTesterComponent()"<br/>{ bearerToken: '', endpoint: '/api/v1/demo/sales', params: {}, response: null }
    U->>Alpine: 貼上 Bearer Token<br/>"tk_a1b2c3d4_X9z8...L5k4"<br/>選擇 endpoint = "/api/v1/demo/inventory"<br/>填入 params = { sku: "SKU-001" }

    U->>Alpine: 點擊 [呼叫]
    Alpine->>Alpine: validate (bearerToken 非空)
    Alpine->>Alpine: isLoading = true（按鈕 disable + spinner）
    Alpine->>Fetch: call(endpoint, params, bearerToken)

    Fetch->>Fetch: build URL: /api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=SKU-001<br/>Headers: { Authorization: "Bearer tk_a1b2c3d4_X9z8...L5k4", Accept: "application/json" }<br/>(Bearer 端點不需 X-CSRF-Token；§6.1)
    Fetch->>Auth: GET /api/v1/demo/inventory?sku=SKU-001 (Bearer)

    Auth->>Auth: extract Bearer token from Authorization header
    Auth->>Auth: tokenHash = SHA256(rawToken)
    Auth->>ApiBC: SELECT id, status, user_id<br/>FROM erp_token.api_tokens<br/>WHERE token_hash = $hash AND status = 'active'

    alt Token 有效
        ApiBC-->>Auth: { id, status: 'active', userId: 'alice@erp-org.com' }
        Auth->>Auth: HttpContext.User = ClaimsPrincipal(userId, erp_role)
        Auth->>ApiBC: UPDATE api_tokens SET last_used_at = NOW()<br/>WHERE id = $id (1s throttled)
        Auth->>PocBC: forward request (User 載入完成)

        alt SKU 存在於 mock 資料
            PocBC->>PocBC: lookup mock data: skuMap["SKU-001"]
            PocBC-->>Fetch: 200 OK<br/>{ sku: "SKU-001", productName: "示範產品 A", quantity: 1234, warehouse: "TPE-W01", updatedAt: "2026-05-08T13:00:00Z" }
            Fetch-->>Alpine: response payload + status: 200
            Alpine->>Alpine: response = { ... }<br/>statusBadge = green<br/>isLoading = false
            Alpine-->>U: 顯示 JSON response（pretty-print）+ status badge 200
        else SKU 不存在
            PocBC-->>Fetch: 404 Not Found<br/>{ error: "SKU_NOT_FOUND", sku: "SKU-001" }
            Fetch-->>Alpine: response.error
            Alpine->>Alpine: response = error<br/>statusBadge = red 404
            Alpine->>Toast: show("error", "查無此 SKU")
        end

    else Token 無效（hash 找不到）
        ApiBC-->>Auth: empty result
        Auth-->>Fetch: 401 Unauthorized<br/>{ error: "INVALID_TOKEN" }
        Fetch-->>Alpine: 401 status
        Alpine->>Alpine: response = { error: "Token 無效或已撤銷" }<br/>statusBadge = red 401<br/>isLoading = false
        Alpine-->>U: P06 Inline Error（不觸發全頁 Login redirect — Bearer 與 Cookie 解耦）
    else Token 已撤銷
        ApiBC-->>Auth: empty (status='revoked' 不符合 WHERE)
        Auth-->>Fetch: 401 { error: "TOKEN_REVOKED" }
        Fetch-->>Alpine: 401 status
        Alpine->>Alpine: response = error<br/>statusBadge = red 401
        Alpine-->>U: P06 顯示「Token 已撤銷，請重新建立」
    end

    Note over U: 完整一次 request-response-UI 循環結束（≈ 80~250ms 視 mock 處理時間）
